items.title: The Trade Desk’s Cloud Journey: AI-Assisted Optimization to AI Agents
items.summary: In programmatic advertising, every millisecond counts, and so does every fraction of a cent it costs to process a bid. When a publisher makes an ad opportunity available, a demand-side platform (DSP) has a few milliseconds to decide whether to bid, how much, and on whose behalf. The Trade Desk runs that decision engine on […]
